rows.note: Use 撬開 as the all-purpose verb for forcing a box, door, or other object open.

example.english: We used an iron bar to prise open the wooden crate.
example.traditional: 我哋用鐵棍撬開個木箱。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jung6 tit3 gwan3 giu6 hoi1 go3 muk6 soeng1

rows.note: Use 套出 when extracting information from someone, especially by coaxing or indirect questioning.

example.english: They kept asking questions and finally managed to prise our secret out of us.
example.traditional: 佢問東問西，終於套出我哋嘅秘密。
example.jyutping: keoi5 man6 dung1 man6 sai1 zung1 jyu1 tou3 ceot1 ngo5 dei6 ge3 bei3 mat6
